column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/dap/session.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in session.rs; the others
# move to src/dap/session/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target dap_session --check` after adding an item to session.rs.
# session.rs keeps DapSession, the types its fields hold, and DapEvent, which it returns.
